seriesTitle: Orb: On the Movements of the Earth

episodes.title: Heliocentrism. How About That
episodes.summary: A gifted young student plans to study theology at university, but his true passion is astronomy. One day, he meets a mysterious scholar named Hubert.

episodes.title: And Now… I'm Going to Move the Earth
episodes.summary: Rafal is intrigued by Hubert's heliocentric theory. Later, Hubert is arrested by an inquisitor but he gives Rafal a pendant before being whisked away.

episodes.title: I… Believe in Heliocentrism
episodes.summary: Nowak convinces Potocki to admit to Rafal's heresy. Once arrested, Rafal is given a choice: recant his belief in heliocentrism or submit to torture.

episodes.title: The Fact That This World Is Far More Beautiful Than Heaven
episodes.summary: The duelist Oczy wishes for death so he can escape his hopeless world and go to heaven. His colleague finds meaning in life by observing the stars.

episodes.title: Even If I Die… This World Will Continue
episodes.summary: Gras aborts the mission, placing himself and Oczy in mortal danger from Nowak. They both flee for the mountains, where they find a stone chest.

episodes.title: Move… The World
episodes.summary: Oczy seeks the help of Badeni, the demoted monk who incurred the Church's wrath by turning his curiosity to the riddles of the sky.

episodes.title: Matters Of The Truth
episodes.summary: Gifted scholar Jolenta suffers discrimination as the only girl at an astronomy institute. Badeni seeks resources to prove the heliocentric theory.

episodes.title: We Must Become Icarus
episodes.summary: Badeni offers Jolenta a chance to pursue the truth of the skies, but she is overcome with fear. Afterward, she overhears bold words from Count Piast.

episodes.title: This Is What It Means… To Learn Something, I Think
episodes.summary: A middle-aged Piast vows to prove his professor's geocentric model. In the present, he agrees to let Badeni use his records — on one condition.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.summary: Oczy tells Badeni that he is learning to read and write. Later, Badeni's claim that knowledge should be held by a select few bothers a fellow monk.

episodes.title: Terror
episodes.summary: Nowak gives two rookie inquisitors a terrifying first taste of their new roles. Badeni meets with Jolenta and tells her he has completed his theory.

episodes.title: Heliocentrism Is My Faith
episodes.summary: Nowak asks Badeni to show him his research. He inspects Badeni's premises but doesn't find anything incriminating — until he spots a certain item.

episodes.title: Freedom
episodes.summary: In a medical area within the inquisition chamber, a wounded Oczy awakes to see Nowak, who has kept him alive in hopes of extracting information.

episodes.title: Tonight's Sky…
episodes.summary: Badeni must choose between revealing the location of the heretical documents on heliocentric theory or prolonging Oczy's torture at Nowak's hands.

episodes.title: Is It… My Turn?
episodes.summary: Nowak believes his beloved daughter has been executed as a heretic. Father Grabowski comes across a letter from Badeni containing an unusual request.

episodes.title: It's Time to Begin the Operation
episodes.summary: Twenty-five years later, Captain Schmidt of the extremist Heretic Liberation Front infiltrates a church and steals an important item.

episodes.title: I Could Make a Lot of Money With This Book… Maybe
episodes.summary: A young nomad woman haunted by poverty devotes her life to obtaining wealth. One night, she discovers the book that Frei hid in the abandoned village.

episodes.title: To Liberate Information
episodes.summary: Bishop Antoni orders Draka to hand over the book, but Schmidt's men suddenly intervene. Determined to change her fate, she takes a bold action.

episodes.title: Morality Is Something You Find When You're Lost
episodes.summary: Hoping to track down the people who stole the book, an inquisitor seeks advice from Nowak, who now spends his days drowning his sorrows.

episodes.title: I Love Heliocentrism
episodes.summary: As the Heretic Liberation Front prepares to depart, Jolenta entrusts Draka with a letter. Soon after, Nowak and the inquisitors approach the barn.

episodes.title: The Times Are Changing
episodes.summary: Schmidt and the others regroup with their Liberation Front comrades and begin printing the book. However, a traitor brings their operation to a halt.

episodes.title: Neither of You Will Be Known to History
episodes.summary: As Nowak's group attacks the Liberation Front, Draka and Schmidt begin their escape. Upon reaching town, Draka makes a proposition to Bishop Antoni.

episodes.title: Comrades
episodes.summary: A deluded Nowak turns against Antoni and attempts to burn down the church. Draka fights back and escapes but incurs a terrible wound.

episodes.title: Thaumazein
episodes.summary: Albert goes to deliver an order of bread to a church. While there, he encounters a mysterious priest who encourages him to confess his sins.
Albert leaves the academic gathering and returns home to an awful sight. In the present, the priest gives Albert advice and makes his own confession.
